info.title: Symplast Users Public API
info.description: Authenticated, minimal read-only public surface for practice user identity/profile data.

get.description:
**Required scope:** `practice.users.read`

Returns the practice's active staff and providers, one page at a time. Patients, referring
physicians and Symplast internal accounts are not included.

Ordered by `updatedAt` ascending, then `id` ascending. Follow `next` within a pass.

Delivery is at-least-once across passes: dedupe on `id` keeping the highest `updatedAt`, and resume at
`updatedSince = lastSeenUpdatedAt - 1 hour` (the overlap absorbs daylight-saving changes on the server
and late-committing writes).

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Number of items per page, from 1 to 200. Defaults to 50.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor for the next page, taken from the previous page's `nextCursor`. Pass it back unchanged; omit it for the first page. The `next` link already carries it.

parameters.name: updatedSince
parameters.description: Only items changed at or after this instant (inclusive), as an ISO-8601 date-time; a value with no offset is UTC. To resume a sync, pass the largest `updatedAt` you have already received, or follow `next`. Omit it to start from the beginning of the feed.

403.description: The caller is not allowed to do this. A token without the required scope gets an RFC 9457 problem with code `insufficient_scope`.

get.description:
**Required scope:** `practice.users.read`

Returns one user in the caller's practice. A user this API does not include (a patient,
referring physician, internal or inactive account) is a 404, the same as an id that does not exist.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The legacy user id, unique within the caller's tenant.

403.description: The caller is not allowed to do this. A token without the required scope gets an RFC 9457 problem with code `insufficient_scope`.

data.description: The items in this page, in feed order. Empty when there are none.

pageSize.description: The page size used for this page: the requested `pageSize`, or the default.

count.description: The number of items in `data`; never more than `pageSize`.

hasMore.description: Whether another page follows. Keep paging while this is true.

nextCursor.description: Cursor for the next page, to pass as `cursor`. Null when `hasMore` is false.

next.description: Relative URL of the next page, ready to request. Null when `hasMore` is false.

PagedResponsePublicUser.description: One page of `PublicUser` items. Keep following `next` (or pass `nextCursor` as `cursor`) while `hasMore` is true.

title.description: Short, human-readable summary of the problem type.

detail.description: Human-readable explanation of this occurrence of the problem.

instance.description: URI reference identifying this occurrence of the problem.

ProblemDetails.description: RFC 9457 problem details describing an error response.

updatedAt.description:
Last change to the user record (UTC). Delivery is at-least-once across passes: dedupe on `Id` keeping the highest
value, and resume at `updatedSince = lastSeenUpdatedAt - 1 hour` (the overlap absorbs daylight-saving
changes on the server and late-committing writes). Covers the user record itself; a change to the `usersDbId` link alone does not move it.

userName.description: The user name, or `null` if not set on the underlying record.

displayName.description:
The display name (`"{FirstName} {LastName}"`). A ragged string (extra whitespace) when one of the
name parts is missing — inherited from the underlying data, not corrected here.

firstName.description: The first name, or `null` if not set.

lastName.description: The last name, or `null` if not set.

email.description: The email address, or `null` if not set.

workPhone.description: The work phone number, or `null` if not set.

mobilePhone.description: The mobile phone number, or `null` if not set.

title.description: The title (e.g. "Dr.", "Mr.", "Ms."), or `null` if not set.

gender.description: The gender, a free-form string (no fixed vocabulary at the legacy DB level), or `null` if not set.

npi.description:
The National Provider Identifier, or `null` if not set. Public information (looked up via NPPES),
not PHI/PII — included, unlike the other bounded-context/sensitive fields this resource excludes.

userType.description: The user's role in the practice. Never `patient` or `refByPhysician`: those users are not included in this API.

status.description: Always `true` in practice (inactive accounts are excluded upstream); kept for forward-compatibility.

usersDbId.description:
The linked `UsersDb.Users.Id` (the modern, global user record), or `null` if no such record
exists for this user yet — a `UsersDb.Users` row is created lazily on first login, so this is not
guaranteed to be present. Only the link itself is exposed; none of the bounded-context data that hangs
off it (permissions, security groups, licenses, custom settings) is part of this resource.

PublicUser.description:
The minimal public identity/profile projection of a user. Deliberately excludes SSN, date of birth,
permissions, security groups, custom settings, licenses, EHR-workflow flags, image URLs, role, and
speciality — this is the entire externally exposed field set. NPI is included (see string? PublicUser.Npi) —
unlike the other excluded fields, it is itself public information (looked up via NPPES), not PHI/PII.

PublicUserType.description:
The user's role in the practice. This API returns only `physician`, `nurse`, `admin`, `staff`,
`cosmeticCoordinator`, `nursePractitioner`, or `unknown` (a type this API does not recognise). The
remaining values are part of the shared vocabulary but are never returned: patients and referring
physicians are not included in this API, and `all`, `allPractice` and `allExceptPatient` are filter
values, not types a user can have.

Bearer.description: Bearer access token. Send it as the `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header.

tags.name: Users
tags.description: The practice's active staff and providers; patients and referring physicians are not included. Use a user's `id` to match the user references on other resources.
